findings.text: the manifest's tests: line, which promotion turns into the gate receipt, names the five-file scoped gate rather than the 34-file population command the done_when asserts; the population arms are recorded only under artifacts/evidence_inputs and their own logs, so a reader of the receipt alone sees a narrower measure (107 tests over five files) than the node claims (260 tests over 34 files).

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit: bb5180ce79 rewrites the five cases and their shared helper, a5b0e929c1 and 0775b391f2 add and then correct the evidence fragment; no product file and no deletion-without-replacement appears in the diff.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the 34-file population at both revisions on all_debug with revision, literal command and EXIT= recorded, plus a per-id attribution; population-head.log (260 passed, EXIT=0, bb5180ce79) and population-base.log (5 failed, 255 passed, EXIT=1, dde7b00176) satisfy the two arms, and manifest.md:25-30 gives each id a 'test wrong' verdict with the commit that already carried the behaviour.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the pending_landing population grep -l pending_landing tests/*.py runs green at the node's head and red only at the five named ids on base; the landed change delivers exactly that by rewriting five stale cases, with no product source edited.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, each arm's revision, literal command and per-arm log path, the five failure ids under both arms, per-id attribution citing 521683b87c, 294e725a57 and b217b010d6 (all confirmed present and ancestors of the reviewed head), and a rubric self-check line per dimension.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py, three test files, an evidence fragment and a figures path); the diff touches only three of the test files and the evidence fragment, and the two product files and figures path are unused, which is a granted scope not an obligation.

justifications.durability: the rewritten cases assert literal product outcomes rather than inputs they supplied — test_a_finished_pending_landing_retires_its_run.py:56-58 asserts repair['status'] == 'resumed' and the rebuilt pointer file, and :119-130 assert 'awaiting-merge-repair' across two passes — so restoring the record-only refusal of bc57e4220e reddens them; test_a_resume_hold_ends_when_it_is_judged.py:330 asserts landed == [] and test_no_caller_waits_on_a_promotion.py:281-284 supplies fields the snapshot reads (obligation_snapshot.py:2336 raises without them, as the base arm shows).
justifications.evidence: the two arm logs carry revision, tree, the literal command and a closing EXIT= line (population-head.log:1-39 and :last, population-base.log:1-39 and :last), the scoped gate reconciles to its recorded summary (scoped-gate-1795342786707285477.log:9 '107 passed in 183.63s'), and every figure the evidence fragment cites matches the log it names; the one gap is that the manifest's tests: line names the five-file scoped gate rather than the 34-file population command the done_when asserts.
justifications.fit: the rewritten cases keep the file's own docstring-and-fixture idiom, name behaviour rather than a plan item (test_a_conflicted_promotion_is_sent_back_to_its_worker, test_a_delivered_repair_lands_the_promoted_run), and a scan of the added lines for phase/stage/plan/ticket/version labels returned nothing.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal asks the pending_landing population to run green at head with the same population red at base on all_debug; population-head.log:39-44 records 260 passed, EXIT=0 at bb5180ce79 and population-base.log:39-454 records 5 failed, 255 passed, EXIT=1 at dde7b00176 with exactly the five named ids, and the diff at 0775b391f2 changes only those three test files plus the evidence fragment.
justifications.reuse: the node adds no production definition — the diff is three test files and one evidence HTML page — so no capability is forked; the case that needed a field map extends the existing hand-built state rather than introducing a parallel snapshot helper.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff dde7b00176..0775b391f2 is inside the declared write paths (three test files and docs/evidence/fragments/.../dwlw-the-landing-tests-pass-on-the-primary-branch.html), and the declared product files reckon/crew/pending_landing.py and reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py are correctly untouched because the attribution found no product defect.
